question: In the DX-Scorecard MBR builder, "target comes from the KPI's config/default view" — should the builder read target from live config.json (via overlayRoster) at pull time and freeze it into the draft snapshot or continuously mirror live config, and for manual KPIs how does the "From default view · edit to override" seeding pull the latest value from the default scorecard tab?
recommendation: Do both, along the seam the codebase already defines: FREEZE the target into the draft snapshot at pull/seed time (reconcileRoster/buildSnapshot copy `config.target` into the on-disk snapshot JSON so a locked MBR is self-contained and immutable), while the live Default view keeps MIRRORING config.json read-only via the pure `overlayRoster` (which re-projects `name`/`target`/`drilldown`/`aiUpdateInstructions` at render without mutating disk). A draft's target is therefore snapshotted at the moment you pull, not continuously mirrored into the persisted draft. For manual KPIs, the "From default view · edit to override" seed should pull the latest committed value by carrying it forward from the most-recent (default/latest-locked) snapshot matched by KPI id — the value reconcileRoster/manualSeedValue already seeds — which is itself config/target-overlaid when the Default tab renders; that seeded value stays editable so the analyst can override it before locking.
supporting_points: The repo already splits the two mechanisms by design: `reconcileRoster` (shared by build-snapshot and the draft-seed flow) writes `target: ck.target` from live config INTO the snapshot at seed time, so the persisted/locked draft is frozen and self-contained (ADR-002 immutability), while `overlayRoster` is explicitly the PURE, non-mutating projection that 'lets the Default view reflect a live roster edit without touching the immutable snapshot on disk' — i.e., mirror at render, freeze at pull.

Continuously mirroring live config INTO the persisted draft would break the immutability/audit guarantees the MBR lifecycle depends on (locked snapshots + amendments[] audit trail); freezing at pull time keeps the draft a stable point-in-time artifact while overlayRoster still gives editors an up-to-date view before they lock.

For manual KPIs the seed is a carry-forward, not a live read: `manualSeedValue`/`currentManualValue` fall back to the KPI's committed `value`, which reconcileRoster carried forward from the most-recent snapshot (the Default tab's latest-locked selection, rendered through overlayRoster), matched by stable id — so 'From default view' pulls that latest value and 'edit to override' leaves the transient editor free to replace it before lock-in.
